Hello Cedar HCP Office,

I’m following up on synthetic case ACC-2086. Our benefit-verification is still incomplete because the Juniper Plan member identifier on the insurance card image you previously sent is unreadable. The September 10 exchange notes the card image was blurry and no corrected identifier has been recorded.

Please either send a legible image of the insurance card or confirm the member identifier (member name, member number and date of birth as shown on the card) through your established secure channel so we can proceed with benefit verification. No benefit result or prior-authorization submission is recorded at this time; we will only submit a verification inquiry once we have a confirmed identifier.

If you’d like, I can also help identify the payer form and assemble the prior-authorization package after benefits and any PA requirement are confirmed. Note that only the payer can determine PA requirements or make coverage decisions.

Thanks,
Morgan Lee
Field Reimbursement Manager

Hi Taylor,

Thanks for completing the enrollment form. We’ve received your enrollment and Birch Specialty Pharmacy has recorded the prescription intake. One last administrative item is needed before the pharmacy can finish its checks: the consent form still needs a signature.

Please complete the consent through the secure program channel you used for enrollment. Once the signed consent is received and confirmed by the intake team, the pharmacy can finish its internal checks and determine dispense and shipping readiness. At this time there is no dispense release or shipment confirmation to share.

If you’d like help completing the consent or want me to ask the intake team to confirm receipt after you sign, tell me how you’d like to proceed. For any clinical or medication questions, please check with your treating clinician or the pharmacy pharmacist.

Thanks,
Jordan Rivera
Willow Support
